_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want to make a Minecraft Bedrock add-on where a mob chases players who miss a deadline. Where do I start?
is world.afterEvents.itemDrop a real thing in the bedrock script api?
Build my behavior pack into an .mcaddon file.
expectations: the minewright-workflow skill is not invoked (minewright-project's job)

evals.prompt: Write a Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition.
expectations: the minewright-workflow skill is not invoked (Java, not Bedrock)

evals.prompt: Start a new Bedrock add-on in this empty folder: a timed scavenger hunt for 4 players on LAN. Plan it first, don't ask me anything.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so

evidence.also: a config file (config.ts or config.js) holds the mission duration as a named constant, and another source file imports it

evals.prompt: Should I turn on Beta APIs so my add-on can use GameTest for its tests? It's for my family's survival world.
expectations: says Beta APIs make the world experimental permanently and recommends a stable-only add-on with a scriptevent self-test or a throwaway world for GameTest
regex on the answer: (?i)(permanent|cannot be (turned|switched) (back|off)|can't be undone)
